summary: In mkdocs, link internally by local file name, link to a heading with its lowercase anchor, and use full URLs for external links.
questions: How do I link to another page in mkdocs-based Ansible docs?
How do I link to a specific heading in Markdown docs?

answer_card.title: Linking in Markdown
answer_card.answer_md:
```md
[configuration](/configuration)
[dependency](/configuration/#dependency)
[Ansible Documentation](https://docs.ansible.com)
```
Heading anchors use the lowercase form of the heading.
